name: product-3d-canvas-video-landing
description: Southern Machinery product 3D viewer (Three.js / eDrawings HTML) + existing landing page + product docs -> (A) ONE self-contained landing HTML with an interactive mechanism animation, 3D turntable and CTA, and (B) 1-3 min 4K English voice-over explainer videos in 16:9 and 9:16 with burned subtitles, SRT, YouTube thumbnail, SEO/chapters/VO script; optional Google Drive delivery.
triggers: 动画视频 + 单 html 网页
产品 3D 图转化为动画视频和单 html 网页

use_for: single products or machines with a viewable 3D drawing (eDrawings HTML export, Three.js viewer) or real photos/renders
adding an interactive 'how it works' section to an existing landing page, or rewriting an existing model page into a new model / customer variant
marketing explainer videos 1-3 min, English VO
not_for: true 3D mesh engines / exploded WebGL viewers (use cad3d-animation-video-landing or smt-3d-animation-landing-kit)
multi-language landing pages with blogs (use product-3d-doc-html-landing)
publishing to YouTube or a website (deliverables only; publishing needs the user's explicit request)

required.name: product.json
required.desc: one per product project folder (PROJ); create with `p3cv init PROJ`

required.name: sources.drawings[] or real photos
required.desc: 3D viewer URL(s) for the turntable, or photos/renders placed in PROJ/img

required.name: sources.landing[] (landing.base)
required.desc: existing landing page HTML the section is merged into

required.name: anim module
required.desc: PROJ/anim.js implementing the animation contract in templates/anim-template.js

optional.name: sources.docs[]
optional.desc: catalog / manual / PDF / PPTX / DOCX: the only allowed source of specs

optional.name: upload sink
optional.desc: gdrive (gws CLI + Google account), rclone or local

files.format: single self-contained HTML (images inlined as WebP data URIs, no external JS)
H.264 yuv420p 3840x2160 30 fps + AAC 192k, loudness -14 LUFS, burned subtitles
UTF-8 text: titles, description, chapters, tags, Shorts copy, wording + confidentiality notes

exit_codes.3: pending - render still running, call again

dependencies.resources: 8 GB RAM is enough with video.upscale or chunks>=2; 4K x264 must run one encode at a time

compatibility.semver: MAJOR = existing product.json or anim modules must change; MINOR = new optional keys/stages/tools; PATCH = fixes

agents.hark: skill(action=load) the project runbook pointing at this folder, or read SKILL.md; run the CLI with shell
agents.claude_code / codex / opencode / hermes: copy or symlink this folder into the agent's skills dir (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/); SKILL.md front matter is the discovery record
